probe.text_sample: Appwrite · The open-source cloud for developers and agents Products Solutions Pricing Docs Customers Blog Changelog 58.2K Sign in Sign up Skip to content Breaking We're thrilled to announce Appwrite 2.0 The open-source cloud for agents & devs _ Appwrite is an MCP & agent-first, cloud platform for building and scaling apps at the speed of thought. Give your agents Auth, DBs, Storage, Functions, Messaging, Realtime, and Hosting - all in one place. Start project View docs MCP included Appwrite Acme Corp First Appwrite project Optimized for the frameworks, languages and agents you love _ All the services you need in one platform _ Build with modular products that feel unified from the first prototype to production scale. Build Deploy Protect Scale Learn more about Auth Auth Authenticate users securely with email, SMS, OAuth, anonymous sessions, and magic URLs. Learn more about Databases Databases Model, query, and scale with Appwrite databases or managed PostgreSQL and MySQL, so you can match your use case and team needs. Learn more about Storage Storage Store files with compression, encryption, image transformations, and access control. Learn more about Functions Function
